title: Remodel
dek: Tools, finishes and fixtures for the projects that actually change a house: repainted cabinets, a built-in pantry, better light and a live-edge build.

boards.title: Repainting cabinets, done right
boards.dek: The paint, brush, jig and pull that separate a factory-looking cabinet job from a weekend one.

boards.title: A pantry that stays organized
boards.dek: Containers and pull-outs that make a small pantry or under-stair nook hold more and stay tidy.

boards.title: Light the work zones
boards.dek: Solid, well-made sconces for a pantry, coffee station or reading corner.

boards.title: Slabs, finishes and floor care
boards.dek: Flattening, joinery, epoxy and oil for live-edge tops, plus the right way to clean hardwood.

items.name: Emerald Urethane Trim Enamel
items.why: A water-based, urethane-modified alkyd that Sherwin-Williams pitches for cabinets, doors and trim. It levels out brush marks as it dries, holds up to scrubbing, and resists yellowing better than oil paint, which matters when going from dark cabinets to white.
items.ebay: sherwin williams emerald urethane trim enamel

items.name: XL Cub 2 in. Angle Trim Brush
items.why: A short-handled 2-inch angled sash brush with a nylon/polyester blend that cuts clean lines on door rails and face frames. Bob Vila's cabinet-brush guide named it best overall.
items.ebay: purdy xl cub 2 inch angle brush

items.name: Cabinet Hardware Jig (KHI-PULL)
items.why: An adjustable drilling template with hardened-steel guides and built-in scales, so every pull on every door lands in the same spot. It handles 64, 96 and 128 mm spacings and 2-1/2 to 5 inch centers.

items.name: Edgecliff Pull
items.why: A simple solid-brass bar pull made in the US, offered in several lengths and finishes so drawers and doors can match. Natural brass against freshly painted white cabinets is the classic pairing.

items.name: POP Container 10-Piece Set
items.why: Stackable, airtight canisters for flour, rice and cereal, with a push-button lid that opens one-handed. Kosher.com's container test liked the seal and stacking but noted lids can pop off if dropped.

items.name: Mold Jars
items.why: German-made glass jars with glass lids, rubber gaskets and stainless clamps, sold individually from 5 to 29 oz. The glass is dishwasher-safe and shares lid sizes across the range, so open shelving looks uniform.

items.name: Tower Small Kitchen Steel Rack
items.why: A stackable powder-coated steel riser that doubles a pantry shelf's usable height for cans and jars. It stacks in multiples when one tier isn't enough.
items.ebay: yamazaki tower kitchen rack small white

items.name: Tall Filler Pullout Organizer, 432-TF Series
items.why: A 6-inch-wide, 23-inch-deep pull-out with adjustable maple shelves on full-extension slides, built to turn a filler gap into spice and oil storage. It is for new cabinet construction, so it fits a built-in pantry project rather than a retrofit.

items.name: Cypress Sconce
items.why: A solid-brass arm sconce made to order in Rejuvenation's Portland, Oregon factory. It comes hardwired or as a plug-in with a 9-foot cord, which makes it easy to light a pantry or coffee nook with no electrician.

items.name: Dolores Portable Wall Sconce
items.why: A damp-rated steel wall sconce from Schoolhouse's portable line, about 8 inches wide with a 3-inch projection, so it fits a tight pantry wall or the space above a coffee station.

items.name: Slab Flattening Jig, Full-Size
items.why: A rail-and-carriage router sled that flattens slabs up to 28-1/2 inches wide and 78-1/2 inches long, without a wide planer or drum sander. Woodworker's Journal notes the router's shearing cut nearly eliminates tear-out.

items.name: Wood Bow Tie Inlay System, Starter Kit
items.why: One acrylic template routes both the mortise and the matching butterfly key, which is how live-edge builders stabilize cracks. The kit includes the two-piece bushing and a 1/8-inch spiral bit and needs a plunge router.

items.name: Fathom Deep Pour Epoxy Resin Kit
items.why: A slow-curing 2:1 casting epoxy rated for up to 2-inch pours in river tables and slab voids. That is deeper than the standard ThickSet, so you need fewer layers and get fewer pour lines.

items.name: Oil Plus 2C, 390 ml
items.why: A two-part, VOC-free hardwax oil that finishes in a single coat: wipe on, wait about 10 minutes, wipe off. It deepens the color of walnut noticeably and fully cures in about five days to a week.

items.name: 16.5 in. Spray Mop Kit
items.why: Dispenses Bona's residue-free, water-based hardwood cleaner from a refillable cartridge onto a washable microfiber pad. Rubber corners keep the head off baseboards and furniture legs.
items.ebay: bona hardwood floor spray mop kit
